title: Effect of Semi-sitting Position on Mask Ventilation
brief_summary: We compare the effect on semi-sitting position on mask ventilation in anesthetized and paralyzed obese patients
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Obese patients undergoing general anesthesia

Exclusion Criteria:

* diseases or structural abnormalities in the upper airway
* those who were at risk of aspiration
* cardiovascular or respiratory diseases
* pregnancy
